opportunities.name: Kayak hotel (Stays) search with guests, filters and sort
opportunities.description: On Kayak Stays, search hotels for a given destination, check-in/check-out dates and rooms/adults/children, then optionally apply filters (star class, review score, amenities) and sort by price.
steps: Click 'Stays' in the left nav
Type the destination in 'Where' and pick the matching suggestion
Open the calendar and click the check-in date
Click the check-out date
Open the guests dropdown and set rooms, adults, children (and child ages)
Click the search button
Optionally apply filters (hotel class, review score, amenities, style)
Open 'Sorted by' and choose 'Price (low to high)'

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27–Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sort price low→high
Santa Fe, NM (typed over Las Vegas); Jun 16–Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6–Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults, 1 child (age 7); filters 8+ review, 3+ stars, free internet, family, air-conditioned; sort price low→high
Los Angeles, CA; May 21–May 23; 1 room, 2 adults; 5-star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, set origin, destination, trip type, departure date, passengers and cabin class (including Qatar Stopover), run the search, and pick a flight and fare.
steps: Open the Book widget (Flights or Qatar Stopover tab)
Enter the 'From' city and choose the airport
Enter the 'To' city and choose the airport
Set trip type (one way/return)
Open the departure calendar, pick the date, click Continue
Open Passengers/Class, adjust adults/children/infants and cabin class, click Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
Click the fare box of the chosen flight
Click 'Select fare' on the chosen fare family (repeat for the return/second leg)

instances.values: Doha DOH → Durban DUR; one way; 28 May 23; 2 adults + 1 infant; Economy; Economy Comfort fare
Qatar Stopover: Colombo CMB → New York JFK; one way; 24 Jun 23; 2 adults + 1 child; Premium; Business Comfort fares on both legs

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways partner hotel search (Booking.com)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways Book > Hotels, search the Booking.com partner site for a destination, dates and guests/rooms, then sort or filter the results and open a property.
steps: On qatarairways.com click 'Book' in the top nav
Click 'Hotels' under Plan your trip
Type the destination and pick the suggestion
Open the dates picker and pick check-in and check-out dates
Set adults/children/rooms and click Done
Click Search
Apply sort (e.g. Price lowest first) or filters (neighbourhood, Free WiFi, star rating)
Click 'See availability' / 'Reserve' on the chosen hotel

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; Apr 10–Apr 16; 2 adults, 1 room; sort Price (lowest first)
Washington DC; Jun 5–Jun 6; 4 adults, 2 rooms; filters Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars; St. Regis → Reserve
